why: WIRED tested 30+ models and covers budget picks (ESR, Lululook, Infinacore), so one major reviewer answers it. Its best overall pick is $98 to $109 and its price data is mixed. The other majors cover single products or over-budget models. The rest are listicles or deals, so a new page could get in but would compete with WIRED.
